purpose: Paired development experiments on the prior native recording; no claim of an independent test set.
frozenInputs: Native RGB/LiDAR and GNSS/IMU preparation from carla_full_perception_20261002. No server access.
firstComparisons: Persistent image overlap association seeded from the first confidence selection; no automatic identity replacement
geometryAndEstimator: Initial comparisons preserve all geometry, dimensions, causal heading, estimator configuration and gains.
criteria: Prior gates: target position RMSE <=0.5 m, target velocity <=1.5 m/s, raw position RMSE <=0.5 m and P95<=1 m, availability>=95% outside injected blackout. Retain every timestamp in estimator metrics.
faultCheck: Repeat actual camera-blackout condition frames150--164; compare full pre-blackout prefix.
scoringPolicy: Prediction completes before separate truth scoring. Known reused development fixture; report all ablations and sensitivity, not tuned test-set success.
